entry.title: AI Adoption Reaches 92.4%, Yet Content Marketing Results Hit a 12-Year Low
entry.summary: AI is now part of almost every blogging workflow, but Orbit Media's latest survey suggests that widespread adoption has not improved content marketing performance. Among 1,042 content marketers surveyed in 2026, 92.4% reported using AI, while only 13.9% said their blogs deliver strong results, the lowest level in the study's 12-year history.
